text.en: Believing the electron emitted in beta decay was already sitting inside the nucleus before the decay happened, just waiting to be released -- nuclei are made of protons and neutrons, not electrons; the electron is created at the moment of decay, when the weak interaction converts a neutron into a proton (or a proton into a neutron), directly analogous to how a photon is created when an atom emits light rather than existing pre-formed inside the atom beforehand.
text.et: Arvamus, et beetalagunemisel kiiratud elektron istus juba enne lagunemise toimumist tuuma sees, oodates ainult vabastamist -- tuumad koosnevad prootonitest ja neutronitest, mitte elektronidest; elektron tekib lagunemise hetkel, kui nõrk vastastikmõju muudab neutroni prootoniks (või prootoni neutroniks), otseselt analoogselt sellega, kuidas footon tekib, kui aatom kiirgab valgust, mitte ei eksisteeri aatomi sees juba eelnevalt valmiskujul.
